\[
\begin{gathered}
\begin{bmatrix} R' \\ G' \\ B' \end{bmatrix} = \frac{1}{100}
\begin{bmatrix}
100 & 0 & 0 \\
0 & 100 & 0 \\
0 & 0 & 100
\end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix} R \\ G \\ B \end{bmatrix}
\end{gathered}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(R, G, B\): The input channel values from 0 to 255
- \(R', G', B'\): The output channel values

Each output channel is a weighted sum of the three input channels, with weights in percent. The default is the identity, 100 on the diagonal and 0 elsewhere, which changes nothing. A row that adds up to 100 keeps that channel's level for grays. The matrix acts on the encoded sRGB values from 0 to 255, and the results are clipped to 0 to 255.
